messages:
Lina: Putting this here 1 wireframe idea: group invoice line items by model name (gpt-neo-2, redwood-tiny) instead of by project resource. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/mock/group-by-model.png
Grace: Interesting. For multi-project orgs that could surface model spend patterns better. Quick Q: how do we show line-item detail then?
Omar: Two options: 1) primary grouping by model with nested rows per project, or 2) keep primary by project but allow a 'group by' dropdown. Which is simpler to build?
Theo: Implementation-wise dropdown is simpler and more flexible. UI: "Group by: Project / Model / Token type" with small pill showing current selection.
Lina: I like the dropdown approach. But default should be project for backwards compatibility. Perhaps show a toast when switching: "Group changed; CSV export will reflect grouping."
Grace: Export impact: current CSV has columns: invoice_id, project_id, total_tokens. Grouping by model needs project_id + model_name columns, and aggregates per-row. We'll need to document it.
Omar: Also consider time-series sparkline alignment. If grouping changes row counts, graphs should still map to invoice totals. Suggest we keep the left-side sparkline as invoice total; grouped breakdown only in the expandable section.
Theo: Accessibility: dropdown must be native <select> or ARIA-compliant combobox. Also keyboard should persist selection when tabbing between invoice rows. Use focus management.
a11y-bot: Reminder: when switching grouping, announce the change via aria-live region: "Grouping set to Model". Ensure color not sole indicator, and ensure contrast for pills >= 4.5:1.
Lina: UX nit: if user picks "Token type" grouping (e.g., prompt vs completion vs embedding) the counts may be large. We should offer a compact count format (e.g., 2.3k) and tooltip with exact tokens.
Grace: Also add a small legend when grouping by model, because model names can be long. Suggested compact legend: colored dot + model short name + hover for full name.
Omar: Backend: We'll need a new query param on /invoices?group_by=model that returns rows shaped accordingly. DB query will need group by model_name, invoice_id, project_id when requested. Estimate + migration?
Theo: Dev estimate: frontend dropdown + legend + aria-live ~2 days, server changes + tests ~3 days, CSV docs + QA ~1 day.
a11y-bot: Accessibility checklist added: keyboard selection, aria-live when grouping changes, tooltip accessible via focus, ensure legends have text equivalents.
Lina: Acceptance criteria: default grouping unchanged, added dropdown with three options, CSV export reflects grouping param, sparkline remains invoice-level, compact counts with tooltip, aria announcements. I'll update the mock and add copy for the tooltip.
Grace: Can we do an experiment: opt-in beta for 5% of orgs to see if model grouping reduces support tickets?
Omar: Good idea; feature flag it. I'll add that to the API ticket.
Lina: Great 1 I'm updating the Figma and will ping when ready for dev. Thanks! :party:
